linley-baruch.name: Linley Baruch
linley-baruch.description: The protagonist of Coiling Dragon, descendant of the Supreme Dragonblood Warriors, master of Earth, Wind, Water, and Fire laws.

doehring-cowart.name: Doehring Cowart
doehring-cowart.description: Ancient Saint Grand Magus of the Pouant Empire residing within the Coiling Dragon Ring, mentor and spiritual grandfather to Linley.

bebe.name: Bebe
bebe.description: Linley's soul-bound magical beast companion; descendant of the legendary Godeater Rat and grandson to Beirut.

beirut.name: Lord Beirut
beirut.description: The supreme powerhouse of the Yulan Continent and sovereign ruler of the Forest of Darkness; creator of the Necropolis of the Gods.

delia.name: Delia Leon
delia.description: Linley’s classmate at Ernst Institute, lifelong companion, and beloved wife who journeyed with him to the Infernal Realm.

stage-mortal.name: Mortal Warrior / Mage (Ranks 1-9)
stage-mortal.description: Ranks 1 to 9 mortal cultivation; foundational manipulation of battle-qi and elemental magic.

stage-saint.name: Saint Realm
stage-saint.description: Inherent flight, immortal lifespan, and foundational mastery over elemental laws.

stage-god.name: God / Demigod
stage-god.description: Condenses a Divine Spark, possesses divine domains, and fuses profound truths of elemental laws.

stage-highgod.name: Highgod (Seven-Star Fiend / Asura)
stage-highgod.description: Fuses all profound mysteries of an elemental law; peak combatants of the Higher Planes.

plane-yulan.name: Yulan Material Continent
plane-yulan.description: Material realm governed by mortal kingdoms, the Holy Union, and the O’Brien Empire.

plane-infernal.name: Infernal Realm
plane-infernal.description: Higher plane of destruction and darkness governed by the Sovereigns; battleground of Fiends and Asuras.

loc-wushan.name: Wushan Township (Baruch Clan Manor)
loc-wushan.description: Quiet countryside village in the Kingdom of Fenlai and ancestral home of the declining Baruch Dragonblood clan; where Linley discovered the Coiling Dragon ring.

loc-fenlai-city.name: Fenlai City (Holy Capital)
loc-fenlai-city.description: Capital of the Holy Union and seat of the Radiant Church; famed for Scented Leaf Avenue, Debs Clan auctions, and the Apocalypse of Daybreak.

loc-ernst-institute.name: Ernst Institute (Continental Magic Academy)
loc-ernst-institute.description: Premier magic academy of the Yulan continent; where Linley trained in earth and wind magic alongside his brothers Yale, Reynolds, and George in Dorm 1987.

loc-magical-beast-mountain.name: Mountain Range of Magical Beasts
loc-magical-beast-mountain.description: Massive primeval wilderness dividing the kingdoms; teeming with fierce magical beasts where Linley survived brutal trials and formed his soul pact with Bebe.

loc-obrien-empire.name: O’Brien Imperial Capital (Channe City)
loc-obrien-empire.description: Mighty martial empire established by the God of War; home to God of War Mountain and the arena where Linley became famous as a stone sculpturing master.

loc-black-dirt-wasteland.name: Black Dirt Wasteland (Baruch Empire)
loc-black-dirt-wasteland.description: Lawless chaos region populated by refugees and warlords, conquered and unified by Linley and the Barker brothers to establish the Baruch Empire.

loc-forest-of-darkness.name: Forest of Darkness (Lord Beirut’s Domain)
loc-forest-of-darkness.description: Untouchable primeval territory ruled by King of Magical Beasts Beirut, harboring a metallic castle and serving as Bebe’s ancestral sanctuary.

loc-necropolis-of-gods.name: Necropolis of the Gods
loc-necropolis-of-gods.description: Gigantic 18-floor planar trial constructed by Lord Beirut, housing the corpses, divine sparks, and artifacts of ancient deities who fell during the planar war.

loc-nightstand-city.name: Nightstand City (Redbud Continent)
loc-nightstand-city.description: Massive teleportation fortress on the Redbud Continent where planar arrivals appear; site of the Demon / Fiend evaluation trials.

loc-chaos-sea.name: The Chaos Sea
loc-chaos-sea.description: Incalculably vast tempestuous black ocean covering much of the Infernal Realm, navigated via metallic lifeforms amidst constant pirate raids.

loc-miluo-island.name: Miluo Island (Bagshaw Clan)
loc-miluo-island.description: Mysterious island sanctuary in the Redbud sea containing the Inkstone and Redbud mist, governed by five elder tribes and the Bagshaw clan.

loc-skyrite-mountains.name: Skyrite Mountains (Four Divine Beasts Clan)
loc-skyrite-mountains.description: Canyon valley stronghold in the Bloodridge Continent where the Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermilion Bird clans struggle under siege from the Eight Great Clans.

loc-indigo-prefecture.name: Indigo Prefecture & Beirut’s Palace
loc-indigo-prefecture.description: Prefecture of Bloodridge Continent overseen by Lord Beirut, where Linley becomes an Elder of the Azure Dragon Clan and Seven-Star Fiend.

arc-early-days.name: Wushan & Ernst Institute
arc-early-days.description: Linley finds the Coiling Dragon ring, trains in magic, bonds with Bebe, and faces heartbreak.

arc-saint-journey.name: Rise of the Saint & Baruch Empire
arc-saint-journey.description: Linley slays the Radiant Church enemies, breaks through to Saint rank, establishes the Baruch Empire, and conquers the Necropolis of the Gods.

arc-infernal-realm.name: Infernal Realm & Four Divine Beasts Clan
arc-infernal-realm.description: Ascending to the Infernal Realm, surviving the Chaos Sea, defending the Azure Dragon Clan, and fusing four elemental laws to become the Grandmaster of the Cosmos.

event-coiling-dragon-discovery.name: Discovery of the Coiling Dragon Ring
event-coiling-dragon-discovery.description: Young Linley pricks his finger on an unadorned black stone ring in the Baruch manor ruins, awakening the Saint Grand Magus Doehring Cowart.

event-ernst-dorm1987.name: Dorm 1987 Brotherhood Formed
event-ernst-dorm1987.description: Linley enrolls in the Ernst Institute and establishes a sworn brotherhood with Yale, Reynolds, and George.

event-magical-beast-survival.name: Mountain Range of Magical Beasts Trial
event-magical-beast-survival.description: Linley and Bebe engage in relentless survival combat against velocisaur and bloodviolet beast packs, forging their battle instincts.

event-breakthrough-saint.name: Dragonblood Transformation Breakthrough
event-breakthrough-saint.description: Linley slays his enemies, vengeance fulfilled, breaking through the limits of mortality into Saint rank.

event-baruch-empire-founded.name: Founding of the Baruch Empire
event-baruch-empire-founded.description: Linley and his five Supreme Warrior brothers sweep across the Black Dirt Wasteland, establishing the great Baruch Empire.

event-necropolis-trial.name: Trial of the Necropolis of the Gods
event-necropolis-trial.description: Linley ventures through the deadly floors of the Necropolis, securing divine sparks, divine artifacts, and achieving godhood.

event-infernal-arrival.name: Arrival at Nightstand City in Infernal Realm
event-infernal-arrival.description: Linley, Delia, and Bebe step through the planar gateway into Nightstand City, beginning their perilous journey across the Redbud Continent.

event-azure-dragon-elder.name: Ancestral Baptism & Clan Elder Inauguration
event-azure-dragon-elder.description: Linley undergoes the Dragon Ancestral Baptism in the Skyrite Mountains, unlocking the complete Azure Dragon bloodline and becoming an Elder.

faction-baruch.name: Baruch Dragonblood Clan
faction-baruch.description: Ancient lineage of Supreme Dragonblood Warriors, founders of the Baruch Empire.

faction-beirut.name: Beirut Domain (Forest of Darkness)
faction-beirut.description: Beirut’s forest realm and divine beasts sovereign lineage in the Yulan Plane.

faction-four-beasts.name: Four Divine Beasts Clan
faction-four-beasts.description: Infernal Realm mega-clan descended from Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Black Tortoise, and Vermilion Bird.

faction-radiant-church.name: Holy Union (Radiant Church)
faction-radiant-church.description: Dominant theocratic superpower of the Yulan Material Plane serving the Sovereign of Light.

faction-obrien.name: O'Brien Empire & God of War College
faction-obrien.description: Mighty martial empire founded by God of War O'Brien, dominant power of the Yulan Continent.

hogg-baruch.name: Hogg Baruch
hogg-baruch.description: Linley's father, Dragonblood warrior lineage, patriarch of the impoverished Baruch clan in Wushan township.

wharton-baruch.name: Wharton Baruch
wharton-baruch.description: Linley's younger brother, successfully underwent Dragonblood transformation at O'Brien Empire capital and married Princess Nina.

hillman.name: Hillman
hillman.description: Sixth-rank veteran warrior and devoted Baruch military instructor who trained young Linley and the guards of Wushan.

yale.name: Yale
yale.description: Eldest brother of Ernst Institute Dorm 1987, heir to the Dawson Conglomerate, and Linley's most generous sworn brother.

reynolds.name: Reynolds
reynolds.description: Fourth brother of Dorm 1987, prodigy of the O'Brien Empire and energetic Wind magus who fought heroically on the imperial frontiers.

george.name: George
george.description: Second brother of Dorm 1987, brilliant scholarly Water and Light magus who served with great administrative wisdom.

alice.name: Alice
alice.description: Linley's first love at Ernst Institute whose heartbreaking departure sparked the creation of the masterwork sculpture 'Dreaming'.

heidens.name: Holy Emperor Heidens
heidens.description: Supreme Pontiff of the Radiant Church, master of angel descent rituals and arch-nemesis responsible for the sacrifice of Linley's mother.

obrien.name: God of War O'Brien
obrien.description: Founder and patron deity of the O'Brien Empire, early martial deity disciple of Beirut who protected the human realms of Yulan for 5,000 years.

high-priest.name: High Priest of Light
aliases: High Priestess of the Yulan Empire
high-priest.description: Supreme Magus and Deity of the Yulan Empire, master of the Elemental Laws of Life and ancient guardian alongside the God of War.

barker.name: Barker
barker.description: Eldest brother of the Five Undying Warriors, descendant of the Supreme Warrior lineages who swore eternal fealty to Linley and the Baruch Empire.

haeru.name: Haeru the Black Panther
haeru.description: Saint-level magical beast subjugated by Linley in the Mountain Range of Magical Beasts, faithful mount and battlefield guardian.

olivier.name: Olivier
olivier.description: Dual Elemental Prodigy of Light and Darkness who invented the Soul-Severing Sword and contested Linley at the O'Brien Empire capital.

desri.name: Desri
desri.description: Prime Saint Grand Magus of Light of the Yulan Continent who lived in secluded cultivation at the Mountain Range of the Setting Sun.

phusro.name: Phusro
phusro.description: Asura-grade Purgatory Commander of the Infernal Realm, ancient Lava Beast Highgod and close companion to Beirut and Linley.

clayde.name: King Clayde of Fenlai
clayde.description: King of the Kingdom of Fenlai, an early 9th-rank combatant who secretly became a Saint rank combatant backed by the Radiant Church. Personally involved in the sacrifice of Linley's mother and the murder of Linley's father Hogg.

stage-sovereign.name: Sovereign (Lesser / Medium / Chief)
stage-sovereign.description: Fused with a Sovereign Spark, wielder of Sovereign's Might, commander of infinite planar faith and cosmic authority.

stage-grandmist.name: Grandmist Creator (Grandmist Controller)
stage-grandmist.description: Transmuted beyond the four elemental realms into the primordial Grandmist Space, inscriber of the Grandmist Canon and universe creator.

plane-netherworld.name: Netherworld Realm
plane-netherworld.description: Higher Plane of death and souls, home of the Netherworld Sovereign and the Netherworld Mountain.

plane-battlefield.name: Planar Battlefield
plane-battlefield.description: A pocket dimension where the Seven Higher Planes and Four Divine Planes clash in the decennial Planar Wars.

plane-grandmist.name: Grandmist Space
plane-grandmist.description: The primordial boundless chaotic void encompassing all cosmoses, realms, and divine planes, ruled by Hongmeng.

loc-netherworld-mountain.name: Netherworld Mountain
loc-netherworld-mountain.description: Shrouded in dense gray mist where souls gather, home of the Red-Robed Messenger and Sovereign of Death.

loc-styx-river.name: Styx River
loc-styx-river.description: Endless soul river crossing the Netherworld, navigated by skeletal ferries under the gaze of Death Gods.

loc-stellar-corridor.name: Stellar Corridor
loc-stellar-corridor.description: Narrow spatial passage connecting opposing planar camps in the Planar Battlefield where Commander-level battles erupt.

loc-nine-colored-channel.name: Nine-Colored Channel
loc-nine-colored-channel.description: Vast spatial rift channel between the Light and Darkness divine armies during the final clash of the Planar Wars.

loc-hongmeng-hut.name: Hongmeng Thatched Hut
loc-hongmeng-hut.description: A modest rustic hut floating serenely in the boundless Grandmist Space where Elder Brother Hongmeng drinks wine and watches the cosmoses.

augusta.name: Chief Sovereign Augusta
augusta.description: The tyrannical Chief Sovereign of Light, master of the Radiant Church and possessor of Overgod artifacts, secretly the light clone of Chief Sovereign of Fate Orloff.

hongmeng.name: Hongmeng (Grandmist Controller)
hongmeng.description: The first entity born of the primordial Grandmist Space and creator of the cosmos. Linley's sworn elder brother who wrote Linley's name into the Grandmist Canon.
